newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends little changed amid EMU talks.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends little changed amid EMU talks.

text.p: 1445 GMT - The Swiss franc ended little changed after moving in narrow ranges as the market waited for details of the single currency project from the European Union summit, dealers said.
The dollar was well bid in early business, but was offered on news that EU officials had agreed a stability pact for the euro, one dealer at a big Swiss bank said.
As long as the dollar does not break above resistance between 1.4470 and 1.45 francs, a test of 1.43 was likely, this trader added.

The mark was stable between 83.20 and 83.30 centimes. *Dollar closes at 1.4380/4390 francs, down from 1.4425/4435 at Friday's close and from 1.4430/4440 at the opening * Mark ends at 83.21/24 Swiss centimes, down a bit from previous 83.27/30 close but up from opening 83.18/21
